name: Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic)
tagline: Classify breast biopsy nuclei as malignant or benign across 30 correlated features.
description:
Created by Dr. William H. Wolberg, W. Nick Street, and Olvi L. Mangasarian at the University of Wisconsin Hospitals, Madison, this dataset comprises 569 digitized fine-needle aspirate (FNA) breast mass cytology specimens. Each specimen is summarized by the mean, standard error, and worst (largest) values of ten nuclear geometry traits—yielding 30 continuous predictors—paired with a confirmed Benign ('B') or Malignant ('M') diagnosis.

In machine learning education, Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic) is the premier introductory binary classification dataset for teaching feature scaling (predictors span six orders of magnitude from ~0.001 to >4,000), severe multicollinearity (radius, perimeter, and area are geometrically coupled), L1/L2 regularization, Principal Component Analysis (PCA), and asymmetric clinical false-negative vs. false-positive decision thresholds.

targetCandidates.description: Predict whether a breast mass fine-needle aspirate is Malignant ('M', positive class) or Benign ('B').

columns.name: ID
columns.description: Unique clinical cytology case identifier assigned at University of Wisconsin Hospitals.
columns.exclusionReason: Unique specimen identifier with no biological predictive value; including IDs causes memorization.

columns.name: radius1
columns.description: Sample mean across nuclei in the FNA image: mean of distances from center to points on the nuclear perimeter.

columns.name: texture1
columns.description: Sample mean across nuclei in the FNA image: standard deviation of gray-scale pixel intensity values inside the cell nucleus.

columns.name: perimeter1
columns.description: Sample mean across nuclei in the FNA image: total boundary length of the cell nucleus contour.

columns.name: area1
columns.description: Sample mean across nuclei in the FNA image: cross-sectional area of the digitized cell nucleus.

columns.name: smoothness1
columns.description: Sample mean across nuclei in the FNA image: local variation in radius lengths around the nuclear boundary.

columns.name: compactness1
columns.description: Sample mean across nuclei in the FNA image: shape compactness index computed as (perimeter^2 / area - 1.0).

columns.name: concavity1
columns.description: Sample mean across nuclei in the FNA image: severity of concave indentations along the nuclear contour.

columns.name: concave_points1
columns.description: Sample mean across nuclei in the FNA image: number of concave portions along the cell nucleus contour.

columns.name: symmetry1
columns.description: Sample mean across nuclei in the FNA image: bilateral symmetry score of the digitized cell nucleus.

columns.name: fractal_dimension1
columns.description: Sample mean across nuclei in the FNA image: boundary complexity ('coastline approximation' minus 1).

warnings: Omits patient demographics (age, race, ethnicity), making it impossible to audit subgroup performance disparities across underrepresented populations despite documented racial inequities in breast cancer mortality.

In oncology screening, false negatives (missing a malignant tumor) carry far graver clinical harm than false positives, requiring learners to evaluate recall/sensitivity and probability thresholds rather than raw accuracy alone.
